title: nephrolepis ensifolia
intro: Nephrolepis ensifolia, commonly known as the sword fern, is a species of epiphytic fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Nephrolepis ensifolia include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
